policy: Per language and per metric the measured value must be >= the pinned floor. Improvements pass and are printed; re-pin them in a reviewed change. No cross-language average.

provenance.model: auto (local model chosen from the repository dominant source language; see SHAPE_AWARE_FUSION_2026-11-22.md)

ubuntu_24_04_ci.note: Pre-relabel floor was identical to the macOS measurement on all four lanes (2 repeats, 0 unmatched).

provenance_checks.repeats: 2 per lane, frozen index, identical normalized unit rankings

ubuntu_24_04_multilanguage.note: Reviewed-head run on ubuntu-24.04. Against the pinned macOS values, nDCG differs by Java +5.4e-3, Rust +4.3e-3 and python +8.8e-4; go and typescript are equal. Java also measures recall +1.79e-2 and precision +1.25e-2. MRR is identical on every lane. Every difference is upward, so no lane measures below its pinned floor; the pins remain the lower macOS measurement.

floor_exception.criterion: issue #58 asks that the Java floor be derived from an ubuntu-24.04 run
floor_exception.decision: kept the lower macOS measurement as the floor
floor_exception.reason: ubuntu-24.04 measures Java nDCG 5.4e-3 higher. Pinning the higher value would fail this same checker on macOS, which is also a supported development platform; the macOS value passes on both. The Ubuntu run is recorded above and passes the floor.
